headline: YouTube is reportedly preparing to settle social media addiction claims for $3 billion
summary: YouTube is poised to settle "addictive design" claims for $3 billion. The settlement addresses harm to children, impacting thousands of school districts. New safeguards for teens are also expected as part of the agreement.

headline: Rockstar says GTA VI made $3.79 billion in its first day
summary: GTA VI shattered records, earning $3.79 billion on its launch day. This marks a new entertainment sales record across all mediums. The game also amassed 32.5 million preorder copies.

headline: Eufy’s Omni C28 is 53 percent off ahead of Black Friday
summary: Eufy's Omni C28 robot vacuum/mop is on sale for Black Friday. Get the hybrid cleaner for $379.99, a 53% discount ($420 off). Find this deal at Amazon, Best Buy, or directly from Eufy.

headline: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
summary: Donald Trump proposes a "tremendous tax" on companies building data centers abroad. This comes amidst growing domestic restrictions on data center construction. Trump aims to prevent US companies from moving data infrastructure overseas.

headline: The Official Lord of the Rings Pizza Cutter Drops to a New Low Price at Amazon
summary: The official Lord of the Rings pizza cutter is now at a new low price. This unique kitchen gadget is available on Amazon. Grab this Black Friday deal for fans of Middle-earth.

headline: RayNeo's Black Friday Sale Includes Discounts on GT Max Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Limited Edition AR Glasses and More
summary: RayNeo's Black Friday sale features discounts on AR glasses. Limited Edition GT Max Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 AR Glasses are included. The sale offers deals on these "portable powerhouses."

headline: Actor Who Plays Mandy in GTA 6 Excitedly Speaks Out After Character Goes Viral
summary: Lexie Shoaibi, who plays Mandy in GTA 6, speaks out. Her character went viral following the game's release. Shoaibi shares her excitement as the game officially launches.

headline: GTA 6 Triggers Busiest Traffic Day in Comcast History
summary: GTA 6's launch caused Comcast's busiest traffic day ever. The company recorded unprecedented internet activity. This marks a historic traffic surge since Comcast's founding in 1963.

headline: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
summary: The UK and EU have agreed on a new deal, says Andy Burnham. The agreement covers food exports, emissions trading, and a youth scheme. This deal paves the way for exploring even closer future ties.

headline: Faisal Islam: This cost-cutting UK-EU deal doesn't mean lower prices will follow
summary: A new UK-EU trade deal aims to cut costs but won't guarantee lower food prices. The deal is expected to boost the economy more than other post-Brexit agreements. Shoppers may not see immediate price reductions despite the trade changes.

headline: Russian missile hits Poland as Kyiv's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
summary: A Russian missile reportedly struck Poland during allied military exercises. No injuries or damage were reported from the incident. Warsaw condemned the event as a "provocation" from Moscow.

headline: What we know about the latest Russian missile strikes on Ukraine
summary: Russia launched major missile strikes on Ukraine. Targets included bridges and railway stations in Kyiv. The attacks represent a significant escalation of hostilities.
